name: Government Polytechnic College, Jaipur
affiliated_to: Board of Technical Education Rajasthan (BTER), Jodhpur & Approved by AICTE

contact.address: Residency Road, Jodhpur / JLN Marg, Jaipur, Rajasthan

overview: Government Polytechnic College, Jaipur is the premier capital institution for technical education in Rajasthan, renowned for academic excellence, state-of-the-art incubation facilities, robotics club, and strong placements in IT, robotics, and core engineering companies.
admission_process: Admissions through DTE Rajasthan centralized online counseling system via SSO Rajasthan. 85% seats are reserved for Rajasthan state domicile candidates, 15% open merit.
eligibility: 10th pass with Science & Math with minimum 35% aggregate marks.
scholarships: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Uchh Shiksha Chhatravriti Scheme.
hostel_facilities: Two modern hostels for boys and girls on campus, spacious dining hall, solar water heating, high-speed optical fiber internet, outdoor sports fields.
campus_facilities: Advanced IoT and AI lab, Cisco networking academy, modern library with IEEE online access, auditorium seating 600 students, cafeteria, gym.
